name: IRONSPIRE VERTICAL: Megastructure Climb Circuit
description: IRONSPIRE VERTICAL is the formalized competitive arm of GLMZ's megastructure climbing scene, sanctioning routes up the exterior and semi-interior service faces of the city's largest habitation and industrial towers. Climbers use a mix of aug-assisted grip systems, magnetic anchor kits, and raw skill to scale faces ranging from 40-story residential blocks to the 180-story Helix Cornerstone tower — the circuit's crown route, completed by fewer than twelve people. Unsanctioned 'ghost routes' on restricted corponation infrastructure run parallel to the official circuit and carry criminal penalties.
story_hooks: A ghost route on the Axiom Central tower leads climbers to a sealed maintenance floor that shouldn't exist on any architectural record — and something inside has been active for years.
The only person to have completed the Helix Cornerstone crown route vanished the same night they finished it; their BCI log cuts out 40 floors from the top.
A young Shelf climber is recruited to run a ghost route to plant surveillance hardware on a corponation tower — but the job is more complicated than it was sold.
